spec_match.rationale: Separates the four 'WebGPU not supported' situations — entry point, adapter, device, and whether this build's WGSL compiler accepts @builtin(frag_depth) greater — and compiles the real shader when a device exists.

interactive.rationale: A run button walks the four steps live with per-step outcomes; verified it ran and stopped honestly at the adapter step in this environment.

blurb_alignment.rationale: The card promises finding out which situation you are in rather than a blanket unsupported, which is precisely the step ladder.

edge_cases.rationale: The headless/VM/blocklisted-driver adapter-null case has dedicated, accurate copy, and later steps stay 'waiting' rather than faking verdicts.

conformance.rationale: The suite mirrors the ladder (entry point, adapter callable, compilation info, modifier compilations); on headless Chromium 141 it ran 3 pass / 4 fail with the compile assertions failing for want of an adapter — consistent with this page's own diagnosis, though those fails conflate no-device with no-modifier-support (see feature-level note).

runtime_evidence.rationale: Chromium 141 headless with --disable-gpu (cloud, no chrome-devtools-mcp): navigator.gpu present, requestAdapter() resolved null, and the detail correctly explained that reporting this as 'WebGPU not supported' would be wrong; console clean, screenshots read.

telemetry_health.rationale: Loads demo-telemetry.js and logs the probe progression.

design_system.rationale: CSS variables, step list with text states, no static card.

accessibility.rationale: Steps are text with per-step descriptions, detail is aria-live, run button is 44px.

mobile_desktop_parity.rationale: No horizontal overflow at 360x740 DPR3 (scrollWidth 360, screenshot read).

summary: Reviewed at http://localhost:3000/v154/webgpu-wgsl-fragment-depth/adapter-probe/ with Chromium 141 headless, --disable-gpu (cloud, no chrome-devtools-mcp). The probe produced the exact honest outcome this environment warrants: navigator.gpu present, adapter null, later steps left as 'waiting', and copy that correctly distinguishes a GPU-less machine from a browser without WebGPU. This page is the reference implementation of the capability-honesty rule for GPU demos. Console/network clean bar the sandbox font-CDN artifact; no mobile overflow; feature /conformance/ ran 3 pass / 4 fail here, consistent with no adapter (noted at feature level that those compile assertions read as fail rather than blocked without a device). Clears the bar.
